messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: What makes the difference?
parts:
You forgot stat = "identity" in geom_bar - that what you need to use
when you don't want ggplot2 to display a barchart of counts. You see
the difference because in one plot your x axis is continuous and in
the other it's discrete.

library(ggplot2)

test <- read.csv2("test.csv", dec = ".")
sektor <- read.csv2("sektoren.csv", dec = ".")

plot <- ggplot(mapping = aes(Jahr, Personen, fill = Branche)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity")
plot %+% test
plot %+% sektor

Hadley
